option.value: --- name: Loona Agora Bridge version: "0.1.68" slug: loona_bridge description: > Playwright/Firefox bridge для видео Loona через Agora RTC (H.264 via built-in libavcodec). Читает /config/.loona/bridge-config.json и подключается по WebSocket к HA Core. arch: - aarch64 - amd64 startup: application boot: manual_only init: false map: - type: homeassistant_config read_only: true path: /ha_config # full_access removes Docker seccomp + AppArmor → allows Firefox GMP child process # to run without double-seccomp conflict on ARM64 Linux (otherwise libgmpopenh264 # crashes on first H.264 bitstream → framesDecoded stays 0 forever). full_access: true # host_network: container shares Pi's network stack directly. # Without this, Firefox inside Docker sees only the Docker bridge IP (172.17.x.x) # and puts that as ICE candidate → Agora edge server cannot route to it → bytes=0. # With host_network the real Pi IP appears in ICE candidates → stable WebRTC UDP. host_network: true options: fps: 10 jpeg_quality: 0.65 schema: fps: int(5,30)? jpeg_quality: float(0.35,0.95)?
